facts.fact: OTR (One Time Registration) is a unique number allotted to the student, valid for the whole academic career on NSP
facts.quote: One Time Registration (OTR) is a unique number allotted to the student and is applicable for entire academic career on National Scholarship Portal.

facts.fact: OTR is required to apply for scholarships on NSP from AY 2024-25
facts.quote: OTR is required to apply for the scholarships on National Scholarship Portal from AY 2024-25.

facts.fact: OTR is generated using Aadhaar or the Aadhaar Enrolment ID (EID)
facts.quote: OTR can be generated using Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrollment number(EID)

facts.fact: The NSP OTR app is available on the Google Play Store
facts.quote: NSP OTR App is available on Google Play Store.

summary: All four OTR facts confirmed on the NSP homepage.
